def export_discoveries(registry: list, csv_path: str = "novel_thermal_discoveries.csv", top_n: int = 20):
    """Save the top N discovered unique compositions with AI-predicted properties to CSV."""
    import pandas as pd
    top_items = registry[:top_n]
    df = pd.DataFrame(top_items)
    # Ensure required columns exist; reorder for readability
    output_cols = [
        "formula", "seed", "bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev", "fitness",
        "generation"
    ]
    available_cols = [c for c in output_cols if c in df.columns]
    df = df[available_cols]
    df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
    best_formula = top_items[0]["formula"] if top_items else "N/A"
    best_bulk = top_items[0]["bulk_modulus_vrh"] if top_items else 0.0
    best_gap = top_items[0]["band_gap_ev"] if top_items else 0.0
    print(f"[Phase 3 Export] Saved top {len(top_items)} discoveries to: {csv_path}")
    print(f"[Phase 3 Export Batch Best] Formula={best_formula} Bulk={best_bulk:.2f} GPa Gap={best_gap:.2f} eV")
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = run_phase3_loop()
    print("Phase 3 complete. Best candidates exported.")
    print("Keys:", list(result.keys()))
